Alex G: Quick Q — we're prepping a POC close and need the CPQ/DealDesk routing for discounts >20%. What fields do I need populated and what's the approval SLA? cc @Maria R :wave:

Maria R: For discounts >20% we need: DealDesk_Approval__c (boolean), Approval_Tier__c, Discount_Reason__c, POC_Duration_months__c, Commit_Level__c, Special_Terms__c. SLA: standard weekday turnaround is 24h for tier-1, 48h for tier-2. If discount >40% escalate to legal. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam T: Also add POC_NDA_signed__c and POC_Success_Criteria__c. For price sheets, include Pricing_Ratecard_Id__c so DealDesk can validate margin.

Maria R: copying the field mapping to drop into SF config:```
// CPQ / SF Field mapping for POC + discounts
Opportunity.Special_Terms__c -> Approval.Special_Terms__c
Opportunity.Discount_Percent__c -> Approval.Discount_Percent__c
Opportunity.POC_Duration_months__c -> Approval.POC_Duration__c
Opportunity.Pricing_Ratecard_Id__c -> Approval.Ratecard_Id__c
Opportunity.DealDesk_Approval__c -> Approval.Status__c
Approval.Escalation_Flag__c -> Queue: DealDesk/Escalations
```

Maria R: Template to use: DD-TEMPLATE-POC-1 (select in CPQ under "Deal Desk Templates"). If you're marking urgent, set Approval_Tier__c = "urgent" and it'll hit the 4hr SLA route. :rocket:

DealDeskBot: New approval request created: approval_id=APPR-20260315-4412. Queue: deal-desk-queue. Link: https://redwood.salesforce.com/approvals/APPR-20260315-4412 :robot_face:

Priya L: Legal note — if POC involves customer data (even pseudonymized) add Data_Retention_Term__c and escalate. Expect 48-72h review for any Special_Terms that change retention or IP. If NDA is non-standard, tag legal_review=true.

Nikki S: I'll start routing in SF now. @Sam T can you confirm the ratecard id? Also remind that CPQ validator blocks if Pricing_Ratecard_Id__c is empty.

Sam T: Confirmed — pricing_ratecard_id=RC-2026-01. Margin calc passes local guardrails. I'll upload the price sheet to the opportunity attachments.

Alex G: Thanks — routing it now and marking as urgent. Maria, please eyeball the approval when it lands. @DealDeskBot ping if anything stalls. :thumbsup:
